dpang po/ lo zla nyi ma/ gnas brtan dge bskos/ len pa po rdzas skyed pa po dang bcas pa'i ye ge rgyas btab ste/ dge slong gzhan yang rgyus shes bcug nas dkon mchog gi rdzas dkon mchog gi don du bskyed kyis dkon mchog mchod par bya'o// bcu pa nyo tshong la rten gzhi dang bcas pa yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba mtshan nyid ni rnam pa zhes so// de yang rten sngon gyi bu lon mi 'khor zhing*/ bu lon (30ba)ma 'khor na ma byin len gyi pham par 'gyur ba sogs kyi rkyen dang mi ldan pa de/ dngos po 'bru gos/ 'du shes 'khrul med/ kun slong rang don du rang gar nyo tshong byed 'dod pas sbyor ba mod nyo dkon tshong gi sgo nas mthar thug khe sgrub pa'i tshe spong ba'o// bslab bya ni/ dge 'dun gyi phyir 'bru nyo bar bya zhing*/ khyim pa'i tshong bar du mi 'jug /rang gi chos gos sogs khyim pa la nyor gzhug /khyim pa med na rdzas kyi rang bzhin drang por gtad nas 'di tsam pa'o zhes bskyed brjod cing*/ dkon mchog gi phyir min par zong la mi rtseg /dus 'dir ma khug na bskyed 'di ltar 'phel bya ba sogs gta' ma mi gzhug /dge 'dun gyi phyir yang rgan rabs la ma zhus par tshong bskyed mi btang*/ 'bru sogs srog chags yod pa mi btsong zhing*/ spang bya phyi ma gnyis bshags pa la de gnyis kyi khe'i cha gtan spang du byed dgos so// sdom la/ lhung bzed gnyis dang tha ga gnyis// byin 'phrog ston zla tha chung dang*// dgon pa ba dang ras chen dang*// bsngos pa dang ni gsog 'jog go /zhes pa'i dang po la/ rten bcang du gnang ba dus rang dang bcas pa ni yang dge slong zhes sogs so// 'das pa ni de la zhes sogs te/ rten dge slong gi dngos po rgyu dang kha dog rung zhing*/ mthe bo'i lto gang gi lhag mar phul dgu shong ba yan chad kyi lhung bzed lhag po'i yo byad du byin gyis brlabs pa sogs kyis rung ba ma byas pa/

'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong rang don du rgyun du 'chang 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba zhag bcu bcangs nas mthar thug zhag bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs 'char ba'i tshe spang (31na)ba'o// yan lag gzhan rnams gos zhag bcu 'chang ba'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin no// lhung bzed lhag po tshol ba'i spang ba la rten bsam pa ni/ yang zhes sogs so// sbyor ba 'das pa ni/ lhung bzed ces sogs so// ltung ba 'di phyir bcos ni dge slong zhes sogs so// rten lhung bzed rung ba tshad ldan yod pa'i dge slong gis khyim pa nye du ma yin pa la dngos po lhung bzed rung ba tshad ldan 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong rang don du slong 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba slong ba la zhugs te mthar thug lag tu thob nas thob blo skyes pa na spang ba'o// lhung bzed med kyang yod pa'i bsam pas slong ba dang*/ yod bzhin du rin gyis nyo ba dang*/ med na rin yod bzhin du bslang ba dang*/ bzang po 'dod pas brje ba rnams la nyes byas so// lhan pa bzhi man chad blan pa'am blan rung la byin rlabs chags/ lnga yan chad du mi chags la/ lhung bzed sogs yo byad la ha cang chags par mi bya/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyi lhung bzed dngos dang*/ rin med na blang du rung la ltung ba 'di phyir 'chos pa'i tshe lhag po gcig dge 'dun la brims pas snyigs par byas la/ lhag po du ma yod na rab tu byung ba gzhan la gtan spang du bya'o// 'thag tu 'jug pa'i spang ba la rten gzhi ni yang zhes sogs te/ sbyor 'das ni gos sogs te/ rten dge slong gi tha ga pa nye du min pa la dngos po gos kyi rgyu rung ba tshad ldan rang gi yin pa/ nye du min pa shes bzhin du rang don du 'thag 'jug 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sbyor ba rang ngam bskos pas brngan pa ma byin (31ba)pa 'thag tu bcug ste mthar thug thob blo skyes pa na spang ba'o// bzhi pa 'thag pa bskyed pa la yul ched du bya ba ni dge slong gi zhes sogs so// sbyor 'das ni de nas zhes sogs te/

sbyin bdag gis rang la dngos po bdog pa rung ba tshad ldan las lhag pa'i sbyin bdag las blangs te 'thag tu bcug na spang ba ste/ yan lag gong bzhin no// lnga pa byin 'phrog la rten yul dang bcas pa yang ni dge slong zhes sogs so// kun slong gi mtshan nyid ni de'i 'og tu zhes sogs so// phyir bcos ni/ 'phrog gam zhes sogs te/ rten dge slong gis yul dge slong mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la dngos po rang gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos gos 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong rang ngam gzhan gyi don du 'phrog 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba rang ngam gzhan bskos pas 'phrog ste mthar thug bral bar bya ba'i dge slong gi lus las chos gos bral na spang ba'o// mi rung ba dang*/ tshad las chung ba dang*/ brgyud nas dang*/ slar sbyin snyam nas 'phrog pa la nyes byas te/ mthar thug gnod par dogs pas 'phrog pa la nyes pa med do// gtad pa las byung ba'i spang ba ni/ rten gyis blang du gnang bar bstan pa ni dge slong gis zhes sogs so// blangs nas bcang du gnang bar bstan pa ni/ blangs nas zhes sogs dang*/ de las 'das pa ni de las zhes sogs te/ rten dbyar gnas pa'i dge slong gis dngos po dbyar khas len la byung ba'i gos kyi rnyed pa rung ba tshad ldan/ dus dbyar khas blangs nas dgag dbye ma byas kyi gong du rkyen dbang (32na)ma gtogs par kun slong dbyar nang du bdag gir byed 'dod pa dang*/ dbyar nang du rang gar bgod 'dod pa dang*/ dgag dbye thon pa'i phyi de nyin ma bgos pa dang*/ sbyor ba de dang de ltar byas te snga ma dgag dbye'i nang du bdag gir byas pa dang bgos pa dang*/ phyi ma sbyin bdag gi tshig gis dbang med nas sped pa ma bgos par dus de dang de las 'das te/ rim bzhin dbyar gyi rnyed pa bdag gir byed snga sa pa dang*/ bgod phyis kyis spang bar 'gyur ro// dgon pa'i spang ba la/ spyod yul gyi grong du bzhag tu gnang ba ni dge slong zhes sogs dang phyi rol tu phral tu gnang ba ni dge slong zhes sogs dang*/

'das pa ni de las zhes sogs te/ rten snam sbyar dang mi 'bral ba'i gnang ba ma thob pa dang*/ sra brkyang ma bting ba'i dge slong gis dngos po rang rang gi chos gos dngos kyi byin rlabs can dgon par 'jigs pa'i dbang gis spyod yul gyi grong du 'jigs pa dang ma bral ba'i bar bzhag tu rung ba la 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong rang gar zhag drug tu 'bral 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba bar chad kyi rkyen med par rang gi gnas dang snam sbyar bzhag pa'i gnas nye 'khor dang bcas pa las mthar thug zhag tu 'das te/ 'dun pa'i skya rengs shar ba'i tshe spang ba'o// ras chen btsal snga sa bzhag phyis kyi spang ba la/ btsal ba dang bzhug tu gnang ba'i dus bstan pa ni dge slong zhes sogs dang*/ yun ji srid bcang ba ni dbyar zad nas zhes sogs dang*/ 'das pa ni gal te zhes sogs so// rten dbyar gnas dang 'brel ba'i dge slong gis dngos po ras chen rung ba tshad ldan char chu skyob nus zla ba bzhir (32ba)longs spyad pa'i rnying pa ma yin pa/ btsal ba'i dus dbyar khas len pa'i snga rol zla ba gcig gi nang du btsal du rung zhing*/ 'jog pa'i dgag dbye thon nas zla ba phyed kyi nang du bzhag tu rung ba las/ kun slong rang don du dbyar khas len pa'i zla ba gcig gi gong du 'tshol 'dod pa dang*/ dgag dbye grol nas zla phyed kyi 'og tu ras chen sbed pa ma bskos par 'jog 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba de ltar byas te/ mthar thug de'i rkyen gyis khas len gyi zla ba gcig gi gong du btsal nas rnyed pa na btsal snga sa kyi spang ba dgag dbye grol nas sbed pa ma bskos par zla phyed kyi 'og tu bcang na bzhag phyis kyi spang ba bskyed do// bsngos bsgyur gyi spang ba ni/ rten gzhi dang bcas pa ni yang zhes sogs so// 'du shes sbyor ba dang bcas pa ni shes bzhin du zhes sogs te/ rten dge slong gis khyim pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pas dge 'dun gyi'am gang zag gzhan la bsngos pa'i dngos po gos sam lhung bzed 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing*/

kun slong rku sems med kyang rang la bsgyur 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba nga la phul zhes brjod pas/ mthar thug de thob pa na spang ba'o// gang zag gzhan la bsngos pa gzhan la bsgyur ba lta bu dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi ka ba la bsngos pa gdung mar bsgyur ba lta bu dang*/ bang rim bum pa la bsgyur ba lta bu dang*/ dud 'gro gzhan la bsngos pa gzhan du bsgyur ba lta bu dang*/ rang gis gzhan la yid kyis bsngos pa mi sbyin pa lta bu nyes byas so// lhag ma za ba'i dud 'gro btsal te ma (33na)rnyed na gzhan la byin kyang nyes med do// gsog 'jog gi spang ba ni/ longs spyad par gnang ba'i dus ni/ bcom ldan 'das zhes so// 'das pa ni de la zhes sogs so// 'don pa'i mjug bsdu ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa zhes sogs te/ rten dge slong nad pa min pas dngos po lha'i bdud rtsi dang*/ snar blug pa tsam las gzhan pa dge slong gis bsten rung gi sman bzhi po gang rung byin len byas pa 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong phyis longs spyod 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sbyor ba rang rang gi gsog 'jog gi dus las 'das pa ste/ phyi dus sman bzhi po byin len ma byas pa nyi ma phyed yan chad bsten du rung zhing*/ dus rung la phyed yol nas byin len ma zhig par bcang na gsog 'jog /bu ram lta bu zhag bdun pa'i sman bdun par byin gyis brlab pa slar zhag bdun las 'das te mthar thug brgyad pa'i skya rengs dang po shar ba'i tshe dang*// na tshod du rung ba thun tshod las 'das par 'jog pa rnams spang ba'o// da ni spang ba'i ltung byed bshad zin pa la/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa la/ spyi sdom ni/ shes bzhin dang ni sa bon dang*// ma bskos pa dang yang dang yang*// chu dang khyim dang bsam bzhin dang*// mgron mang rkun ma chos ston no// de'i bcu tshan dang po'i dngos sdom la// rdzun skyon dge slong phra ma dang*// skyo sngogs byed dang ston pa dang*// 'don dang gnas ngan len dang chos// bshes ngor byed dang khyad du gsod// ces pa'o// bden pa'i lung 'bogs pa ni/

tshe dang ldan pa zhes sogs so// 'du shes kyi mtshan (33ba)nyid ni/ shes bzhin du zhes sogs so// brjod bya sbyor ba dang bcas pa ni rdzun du zhes sogs te// de yang bcas ldan dge slong gis pham par gyur pa'i rdzun dang*/ shes bzhin du chos ma yin pa la chos dang chos yin pa la chos ma yin par ston pa sbom por 'gyur ba'i rdzun dang*/ gso sbyong gi tshe ci 'di la khyed yongs su dag gam zhes lan gsum du dris pa na cang mi smra bas 'da' bar byed pa lta bu nyes byas su 'gyur ba'i rdzun dang*/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dge 'dun lhag mas skur pa 'debs pa'i rdzun rnams las gzhan pa'i rdzun rnams shes bzhin gyi rdzun no// 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong smra 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sbyor ba rang gis smras te mthar thug nyan pos brda sprod pa'i don go ba na ltung ba'o// bslab bya ni dkon mchog sogs la mna' 'dor bar mi bya'o// skyon smra ba'i gzhi ni mi'i zhes sogs so// sbyor ba ni smra na zhes sogs te/ rten dge slong gis yul dge slong pha rol po la 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong skyon brjod 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sbyor ba yul dus der skyon du grags pas/ tshig 'jam rtsub gang gi smras kyang rung mthar don go ba na dge slong de mi dga' bar ma gyur kyang ltung ba'o// skyon de 'don par 'dod par gyur pa'i phan sems kyis smras pa la ltung ba med do// phra ma la/ gzhi ni dge slong zhes dang*/ sbyor ba ni phra ma zhes te/ rten dge slong gis yul dge slong mthun pa dbye 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sbyor ba ming nas smros te phra ma'i tshig smras pa mthar thug don go (34na)ba na ltung ba'o// skyo sngogs la/ gzhi ni yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba ni shes bzhin te/ de yang rten rtsod pa'i rgyu shes bzhin zhi byed la gtogs pa'i dge slong gis yul dge slong pha rol po dag gi chos kyi rtsod pa bzhi po gang rung dge 'dun gyis chos phyogs su zhi bar byas pa 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong rtsod pa dkrug 'dod kyi bsam pas/

sbyor ba khyed cag gi rtsod pa de legs par zhi bar byas pa ma yin ces sogs skyo sngogs kyi tshig brjod pas mthar thug yul gyis don go ba na ltung ba'o// zhi byed la mi gtogs pa dang*/ chos min pa'i phyogs su zhi bar byed pa la skyo sngogs byas na nyes byas so// khyim pa mo la chos ston pa ni/ rten yul dang bcas pa ni yang zhes sogs so// sbyor ba dmigs bsal dang bcas pa ni ston na zhes sogs te/ rten dge slong gis yul bud med khyim pa mo nye du ma yin pa lus bsten du rung ba smra shes don go ba/ rdzu 'phrul can dang mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can ma yin pa 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong chos ston 'dod kyi bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba gnas gcig tu khrims grogs med par bka' la gtogs pa'i chos tshig lnga'am drug las lhag par ston te/ mthar thug don go ba na ltung ba'o// bud med mkhas pas chos dris pa sogs dang*/ dus khrims 'bogs pa dang*/ yon bshad pa 'di la ltung ba med do// 'don pa ni rten yul yang zhes pa dang*/ sbyor ba ni 'don na zhes rten dge slong gis 'don pa'i dngos po bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos bsnyen par (34ba)ma rdzogs pa dang gcig car ram/ mjug thog tu sbyor ba mi 'dod bzhin dbang med ma gtogs/ 'don pas mthar thug don go na ltung ba'o// gnas ngan len brjod pa ni/ rten yul ni yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal ni brjod na zhes te/ rten khyim pa ma dad pa bzlog pa'i phyir gnas ngan len brjod par ma bskos pa'i dge slong gis/ brjod pa'i yul byung ba dang bcas pa mi shes pa'i bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa'i gang zag la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gso rung yan chad dang ldan pa'i gnas ngan len brjod pas/ sbyor ba pham lhag gang rung gi gnas ngan len smras pa mthar thug don go ba na ltung ba'o// bla ma bden par smras pa ni/ rten yul dang bcas pa ni yang zhes dang*/

brjod bya sbyor ba dang bcas pa ni mi'i chos te/ rten dge slong gis yul ma rdzogs pa dang*/ bden pa ma mthong ba la dngos po rang gis thob pa'i sgom byung gi yon tan 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong de smra 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba rang gis thob pa'i chos bla ma 'du shes ma bsgyur bar smras te mthar thug don go ba na ltung ba'o// bshes ngor byed pa ni/ rten yul dang bcas pa ni yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba gzhi bcas ni de'i 'og tu zhes te/ rten dge slong snga ra rnyed pa de'i yul la bsngos pa la dad pas phul ba yul dge 'dun dngos po zas las gzhan pa'i rnyed pa phal cher rung ba tshad dang ldan pa 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong 'du shes bsgyur te skur pa 'debs 'dod kyi bsam pas rnyed pa sbyin par mi rigs pa la bsngos so zhes smras te mthar don go ba na ltung ba'o// khyad du gsod pa dus dang bcas pa (35na)ni yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba ni 'di skad ces te/ rten dge slong gis yul dge slong dag la gso sbyong gi dus su 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing kun slong khyad du gsod 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sbyor ba bslab pa 'di lta bu 'don pas ci zhig bya zhes khyad du gsod pa'i tshig smras te mthar thug don go ba'o// bcu tshan gnyis pa ni/ sdom la/ sa bon 'phya ba bsgo ba dang*// khri dang gding ba bskrod pa dang*// phyis gnon 'byung ba 'debs pa dang*// rim pa gnyis su brtsig pa'o// sa bon skye 'jig la gzhi ni sa bon zhes dang*/ sbyor ba ni 'jig gam zhes sogs te/ rten dge slong gis dngos po nas la sogs sa bon gang rung ma nyams pa/ rung bar ma byas pa/ rang gi ngo bo rdzogs pa la/ 'du shes sa bon dang skye ba ma nyams pa la der 'du shes pa'am yid gnyis za bas// kun slong de nyams 'dod kyi bsam pa sbyor ba rang rtsas bcings pa'i rkyen dang rdzu 'phrul gyis min par rang ngam gzhan bskos pas mngon sum du nyams par brtsams te mthar thug nyams par gyur na ltung ba'o// sbyor ba gcig gis 'bras bu mang po nyams par byed na/

sbyor ba ni gcig yin la dngos gzhi ni 'bru'i grangs yin no// shing sdong lta bu dngos po gcig la dngos gzhi ni gcig yin la sbyor ba ni bsnun pa'i grangs so// shing lta bu rtsa thon du byas te gzhan du bskyed pa dang*/ nya lcibs chu nang nas bton pa lta bu dngos gzhi'o// pha ba dgo dgo dang*/ sha mang sogs dang*/ go snyod sogs la rlam pa dang*/ 'dab ma skya bo kha bye ba dang*/ bskum pa dang*/ 'bras bu smin pa bral bar byas pa dang*/ rdo drig phrug pa dang*/ tshig gu ril med du byed pa dang*/ skye ba 'joms pa legs 'gyur du smras (35ba)pa rnams la nyes byas so// rung bar bya ba la me sen/ ne tso/ mtshon sogs kyis rma byung ba dang*/ 'bras bu smin par gyur te bskyed mi nus pa dang*/ la phug rtsa phyung dang*/ sran ma phyed tshal du bkrum pa dang*/ shing sogs bcad pa lta bu dang*/ rlangs pa la bdug pa dang*/ 'bru'i phung po la phyogs gnyis gsum nas rung ba lta bu'i skye ba la dge slong gis bcom yang 'di'i skabs kyi ltung byed min la/ dus rung min pa'i sman gsum la chu grang mo gtor nas rung ba ni khol ba'i dus su ma yin no// 'phya ba la 'phya'am zhes sogs te/ rten dge 'dun gyis gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las kyis dman pa'i grangs su bgrangs pa'i dge slong gis yul lung las/ gnas khang zas la bsko ba gnyis// ga pa bag tshos 'grim pa gnyis// phran tshegs 'brim par byed pa dang*// snod spyad 'brub dang gos kyi gnyis// dbyar gyi ras chen sbed dang 'gyed// mngags gzhug pa dang mdzes chos te// gang zas bcu dang gnyis po dag /ston pas yang dag bshad pa yin// ces bskos pa'am ma bskos kyang zhal ta pa la kun slong 'phya 'dod kyi bsam pas 'du shes bsgyur te/ sbyor ba bdag nyid dang 'brel ba'i don gyis yul des thob pa ming nas smos te gsal por 'phya ba'am/ ma smros par gzhog 'phyas byas kyang rung*/

don go ba na ltung ba'o// bslab bya la/ gleng ba dang du mi len pa la dngos su mi gleng*/ rang dang zhe 'gras pa rang las su mi bsko'o// bsgo ba rnar gzon la tshig don ni go sla la/ rten gzhan gyi srog skyob pa sogs dgos pa khyad par can dang mi ldan pa'i dge slong gis/ dge slong pha rol pos chos (36na)mthun gyis dris pa la dge slong rnal gzon 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sbyor ba lan log 'debs smra bar brtsam ste mthar thug don go ba na ltung ba'o// lan mi smra ba dang*/ mi dran zer ba nyes byas so// bsad bya mthong ngam zhes 'dri ba la/ re zhig ma 'dri zhig ces sogs dang*/ btags pa'i bdag la bsam nas bsad bya ma mthong ngo zhes smras pa la ltung ba med do// bslab bya la/ che bzhi sar mi bsdad cing sdod na'ang gnod pa mi 'gug pa'i dpang por bya'o// gnas mal la rten gzhi ni yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal ni de nas zhes sogs te/ rten dge slong gis dge 'dun gyis gnas mal la longs spyod nas bla gab med par rang gis ma bsdus pa'am/ gzhan sdud du ma bcug par rang gar 'dor 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba de ltar bzhag cing*/ de nyid du 'dug pa'am 'gro bar brtsam pa/ rkyen des phan phun du gyur tam ma gyur kyang*/ gnas 'dom zhe dgu 'das par phyin na ltung ba'o// gang zag gi la nyes byas so// phan phun ni gsum ste/ rlung gis bzlog pa dang*/ char pas rim pa gzhan phig pa dang*/ srin bu la sogs pas kyang ngo*// gding ba la rten gzhi ni yang dang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal ni de nas zhes te/ rten dge slong gis gnas gtsug lag khang du srog chags phra mo skye ba'i sar rtsa dang lo ma la sogs kyi gding ba bting ba de/ bsam sbyor mthar thug snga ma dang 'dra/ bslab bya la/ dgon par rtsa dang lo ma bting ba dor ba'am/ steng 'og bsgyur bar bya/ khyim gzhan du bting ba'i tshe khyim bdag la dris nas 'dor bar (36ba)bya/

lci ba dang shing la sogs pa srog chags skye ba'i sar mi bzhag /'chag sar bting ba dang*/ gos ska ma pa'i phyir bting ba ma dor na nyes byas so// bskrad pa la rten bsam pa ni yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal ni bskrod dam zhes sogs te/ rten dge slong gis gnas gtsug lag khang nas dge slong pha rol po rang gar skrod 'dod kyis sbyor ba de las gnod pa bsal ba'am/ dge 'dun 'khrugs pa zhi ba'i phyir sogs min par rang ngam bskos pas skrod par brtsams te/ rkyen des gtsug lag khang nye 'khor dang bcas pa las 'das na ltung ba'o// gang zag gi gtsug lag khang dang*/ khyim pa'i gnas nas dang*/ bzhad gad tsam gyi phyir dang*/ nye 'khor las ma 'das tsam du skrod pa nyes byas so// phyis gnon las 'das ltung ba'o// rten dang gzhi ni/ yang dge slong zhes dang*/ 'du shes sbyor ba ni shes bzhin du zhes te/ rten dge slong gis gnas dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang du dge slong snga ra zhugs la kun slong tho 'tshams pas sbyor ba ni 'jigs pa'i dbang min par lus ngag gang rung gis phyis gnon du brtsam ste/ de zil gyis mnan na ltung ba'o// rtsa ba dbyung ba la/ rten gzhi yang dge slong zhes dang*/ 'du shes sbyor ba ni shes bzhin du zhes te/ rten dge slong gis dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang gi thog brdol ba'i nyes byas la khri'am khri'u'i rtsa ba rnon po rkang rten med par sbyor ba de la 'dug cing nyal ba'i bya ba rdzogs pa na ltung ba'o// 'debs pa la rten bsam pa ni/ yang dge slong dang*/ gzhi sbyor ni srog chags zhes te/ rten dge slong gis chu dang rtsa shing sogs srog (37na)chags snang bzhin du der shes te rang don du longs spyod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba rang ngam bskos pas brtsams te rkyen des srog chags ji snyed shi ba de snyed kyi ltung ba'o// rim gnyis su brtsigs pa la/ rten gnang pa'i tshad ni yang dge slong zhes dang*/

tshad 'das ni/ de las lhag na zhes te/ dge slong gis spyod lam bzhi shong yan chad kyi gtsug lag khang de nyid dang nyi ma de nyid dang*/ gzhan la yang 'jim pa med par pha gu rim pa gsum las lhag par brtsigs/ chu khung ma btod/ rmang bskos te ma btsugs par sgo glegs gong ma ma bcug pa na/ sbyor ba sbyin bdag gi rings rkyen med par rang ngam bskos pas brtsams te rim pa lhag ste myur du 'jig nyen ltung ba'o// bcu tshan gsum pa ni/ sdom la/ ma bsgos nyi ma nub pa dang*// zas dang chos gos gnyis dag dang*// don mthun gru dang dben pa gnyis// dge slong ma yis sbyor bcug pa'o// zhes pa las/ ma bskos par ston pa la rten yul ni/ yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal ni ston ces te/ 'di phyin chad rten gzhi'i yan lag don gyis go bar byas te ma smos pa yin la/ des rten mi chos bla ma'i mthu dang mi ldan cing*/ dge slong ma'i ston par gsol ba ma btab ma bskos/ bskos kyang mtshan nyid ma tshang ba'i dge slong gis sbyor ba dam chos bstan na don go ba na dngos gzhi'o// nyi ma ma nub kyi bar du ston pa la rten gzhi ni/ dge slong zhes dang*/ sbyor ba mtshan nyid ni ston na zhes te/ yul dge slong ma'i ston par bskos kyang dge slong ma la nyi ma nub kyi bar du ston na/ mthar thug (37ba)don go na dngos gzhi'o// zas cung zad kyi phyir ston pa la rten gzhi ni dge zhes dang*/ sbyor ba mtshan nyid ni ston to zhes te/ dge slong pha rol po zas gos kyi phyir chos ston pa ma yin pa la/ 'du shes bsgyur te skur pa btab 'dod kyis sbyor ba zas tsam gyi phyir chos ston to// zhes ming nas smos te skur pa 'debs pa tsam don go ba na ltung ba'o// gos byin pa la/ rten gzhi dang bcas pa ni/ yang dge slong gang*/ sbyor ba ni sbyin na zhes te/ dge slong ma'i dge 'dun la gos 'bul ba dang*/

phog pa la sbyin pa ma gtogs par dge slong ma nye du min pa la mdza' bshes kyi nor ster 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba brtsams te yul gyis gos thob na ltung ba'o// gos byed pa la rten yul ni yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba gos byed na zhes te/ dge slong ma nye du min pa'i gos kyi bzo rang gar bzo 'dod kyi bsam pas mthar thug bzo rdzogs na ltung ba'o// dge slong ma dang lhan gcig lam du 'gro ba ni/ rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal ni 'gro na zhes sogs te/ rten dge slong na ba sogs kyi rkyen med par dge slong ma nye du min pa dang sa'i lam la rgyang grags las 'das par 'gro na/ mthar thug rgyang grags re 'das pa na ltung ba re re/ rgyang grags phyed phyed na nyes byas re yin la/ dge slong ma dang lhan gcig gru la 'jug na rten gzhi ni yang dge slong dang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal ni gyen du zhes te chu la thad kar 'gro ba dang*/ gru yob dang stib chad sogs rkyen dang khrims grogs med par rgyun nam rgyun las bzlog ste snga ma dang 'dra'o// dben pa na 'dug pa la/ rten (38na)dang gzhi ni yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba la stan zhes te/ yul bud med nye du min pa/ dben pa skyabs yod 'dom gang gi bar du khrims grogs med par yul rten gnyis ka spyod lam rdzogs pa'i bar du 'dug na ltung ba'o// 'greng ba la rten gzhi ni yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba ni 'greng na zhes te yan lag snga ma bzhin las 'greng ba ni khyad par ro// dge slong ma sbyor du bcug pa ni rten 'du shes ni yang zhes dang*/ gzhi sbyor ba ni dge slong mas zhes te/ dge slong ma nye du min pas sbyin bdag khyim pa la rang mngon rtogs sogs kyi yon tan mi ldan pa la ldan ces rdzun gyis dus rung gi zas sbyor bcug pa kun slong dge slong mas yang dag min pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas sbyor bcug pa za 'dod kyis mthar thug mgul du mid pa na ltung ba'o// sdom la/

yang yang dang ni 'dug gnas gcig /phye dang bcas dang stobs pa dang*// 'dus dang dus min gsog 'jog dang*// kha nas mid dang bsod pa nyid// ces pa'i yang yang za ba la ltung ba dmigs bsal ni yang yang zhes dang*/ gnang ba'i dus ni de la zhes te/ na ba dang*/ phyags dar ba mal tsam dang*/ dpag tshad phyed phyin pa min cing sra brkyang gi dus min pa gcig la mgron du bos pa gnyis las phyi mar khru gang du longs pa'i gos rnyed pa min par bza' ba lnga dang bca' ba lnga'i khongs su gtogs pa'i dus rung gi zas tshad longs/ sbyor ba mu ge'i dus min par brtsams te mgul du mid pa na ltung ba'o// bslab bya ni mgron la snga tshoms su mi 'jug /rang 'khor la brtags te spyod lam mdzes par 'chos/ (38ba)gya tshoms su rung gi zan mi bcad do// 'dug gnas gcig tu za ba la/ rten gnang ba'i tshad ni 'dug ces dang*/ 'das pa ni de las zhes te/ rten dge slong min pas mu stegs can sha stag gi gnas su mu stegs byed kyi sbyin bdag nye du min pas ci bder ma bstab bzhin du kun slong zhag lon pa'i zas za 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba zas gnyis pa za bar brtsams te mgul du mid na ltung ba'o// lhung bzed do gsum las lhag par len pa la/ bslang du gnang ba'i tshad ni dge slong zhes dang*/ 'das pa ni de las zhes dang*/ de las lhag par bslangs nas ci ltar bya na/ lhung bzed gang ba zhes sogs te/ sbyin bdag khyim ba zas ci bder stob pa min pa la/ dus rung las su byas pa lhung bzed chung tshad gsum 'bring tshad do// che tshad gang las lhag pa gnas de las gzhan du khyer te za bar brtsams te mgul du mid pa na ltung ba'o// gzhan gyis len pa dang*/ sman gzhan gsum las de ltar nyes byas so// gnas de nyid du lhag pa zos pa dang*/ g.yos su ma byas lhag par blangs te zos pa la ltung ba med do// spangs pa za ba la rten gzhi ni yang zhes dang*/

sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni 'cha'am za na zhes te/ rten dge slong nad pa min pas bza' bca'i khongs gtogs dus rung gi zas thug pa dang skyo ma min pa/ de ring da ni mi za'o snyam nas spangs pa rdzogs pa/ lhag por byin gyis ma brlabs pa sbyor ba mu ge'i dus min par mgul du mid na ltung ba'o// sman gzhan gsum dang*/ kha gzar gyen du mi 'greng pa'i thug pa dang (39na)sor mo'i rjes mi mngon pa'i skyo ma'i ltung ba rnams la spang bya'i ltung ba mi 'byung la/ bkres pa sogs kyis spangs pa nan gyis za na lhag por byin gyis brlabs te za'o// spangs pa stob pa la/ rten bsam pa ni spang dang*/ yul phyed ni dge slong dang*/ sbyor ba ni tshe dang ldan pa zhes te/ mu ge'i dus ma yin pa dus rung gi zas tshad ldan dge slong gis lhag por ma byas pa'i zas stob 'dod kyi bsam pas lhag par byas te stob par brtsams te/ yul dge slong gis zos na stob pa po la ltung ba'o// dge slong la chang dang dgong lto zar 'jug pa ni skabs 'di'i nyes byas so// 'dus shing za ba la dngos dmigs bsal ni/ 'dus shing zhes dang*/ gnang ba'i dus ni de las zhes te/ 'dus pa chen po'i dus min par mtshams nang gcig tu dge 'dun spyi las logs su dge slong gsum yan chad lhan cig dus rung gi zas tshad ldan za bar brtsams te mid pa na ltung ba'o// na ba dang*/ las byas pa dang*/ sra brkyang bting ba la 'di mi 'gyur ro// dus min par za ba la rten bkag pa'i dus ni/ yang zhes dang*/ gzhi sbyor ba ni bca'am zhes sogs te/ na ba sogs rkyen med par dus rung gi zas rang gling gi nyi ma phyed yol nas rkya rengs dang po ma shar gyi bar sbyor ba brtsams te zos na kham re la ltung ba re'o// gsog 'jog za ba'i rten gzhi ni/ yang dang*/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ 'cha'am zhes te/ na ba sogs rkyen med par sman bzhi po gang rung byin len byas shing gsog 'jog byas te/

ma zhig par mu (39ba)ge'i dus min par za bar brtsams te mgul du mid na ltung ba'o// 'di las 'phros pa'i lag nya ni thog shas bgod pa dang*/ snod nas 'khrud pa dang*/ nor ba dang*/ brjed pa dang*/ chud mi za ba'i rkyen med par myur du longs spyod pa'i zas sam/ 'bru sogs ma byin len gyi chad min par reg na lag nya/ khyim pa'i gnas dang*/ rung khang min par dge slong rang dbang ba'i mtshams dngos sam/ nye 'khor gyi nang du 'bru sogs rjen pa 'tshos par mtshams btsos/ bzhag ma'i gnas dang 'jog pa'i dngos po snga ma bzhin la rjen pa ma btsos kyang zhag gcig 'das nas zhag lon/ na ba'i rkyen med par 'bru sogs dge slong gis mtshams phyi nang gang du btsos kyang dge slong gis btsos par 'gyur ro// kha dri ma can gyis zos na nyes byas so// byin len ma byas par za ba la// rten gzhi dang bcas pa ni yang dang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal ni za na zhes te/ gnas byang sgra mi snyan min par nad pa la phan pa'i rkyen med par sman bzhi po gang rung byin len ma byas pa med par brtsams te mid pa na ltung ba'o// byin len ji ltar 'os pa ni/ len pa po dge slob ma yan chad bslab pa gso rung*/ dngos po sman bzhi po snga ra byin len ma byas pa/ stob pa po ni bslab bya byin/ dge slong ma dang*/ dge tshul ma man chad/ rdzas gyen du 'degs nus/ khru gang las ma 'phags pa/ mdun drang po nas mtshams gyis bar ma chad pa las thob pa'o// dmigs bsal ni/ spre'us shing thog nas byin pa lta bu dang*/ rta cang shes lta bu la sogs (40na)pa yang mtshon no// mtshams gzhan mkha'/ me chu/ rags pa ste bzhi bsnan pa'am/ 'brel bar ma byas na mi 'thob la/ kha cig /bdag po mtshams gzhan kyang 'dod/ byin len la lnga/ lus kyis lus su len pa/ lus dang 'brel bas lus dang 'grel ba las len pa/ lus kyis lus dang 'brel pa las len pa/ lus dang 'brel pas lus su len pa/

bzhag pa'i byin len dang lnga las/ zas 'dren pa na 'phang bar zhog ces pas bzhag pa yang der 'gyur ro// byin len 'jig pa'i rgyu brgyad ste/ zho las mar gyur dngos po gzhan gyur/ sa bon las myu gu lta bu skye ba gzhan gyur/ dge slong min par gyur pa dang*/ byin len byed 'phro rang gis 'phrog pa dang*/ ma rdzogs pa la bsngos pa dang*/ lag pas len mi nus pa'i sar 'dril ba dang*/ nam mkhar snyogs par 'phangs pa dang*/ rang gis ma bzung bar bsnyen par ma rdzogs pas reg pa rnams so// stob po gzhan med na sbyin bdag gis bsam pa thag pa nas btang ba blos bzung ba la ltung ba med do// byin len dang shing thog rung ba byed mkhan med na nyi ma dang por zas bcad/ de nas nyi ma dang por spar gang*/ gnyis pa la spar do/ gsum pa la ji tsam zos kyang byin len dang rung ba'i go chod/ za ba'i tshe sgra mi snyan yid la byed pa'o// bsod pa blang ba la bsod pa'i dbye ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das zhes so// rten ched ni yang zhes dang*/ gzhi sbyor ba dang bcas pa ni/ zas bsod pa zhes so// rten dge slong na ba min pa/ 'o ma dang zho sogs (40ba)yul dus der ro bro'am bsod par grags pa khyim pa nye du ma yin pas ci bder ma bstabs pa mid pa na ltung ba'o// sdom la/ srog chags bcas dang nyal bar 'dug /'greng dang gcer bu dmag dang ni// zhag gsum bsham dkrug 'gro ba dang*// brdeg dang gzas dang gnas ngan len// ces pa'i srog chags dang bcas pa la spyod pa la/ rten bsam pa ni yang zhes dang*/ gzhi sbyor ba ni srog chags zhes te/ rang don du srog chags dang bcas pa'i chu la khrus dang*/ btung ba dang*/ chos gos sogs kyi ched du longs spyod pa dang*/ srog chags can gyi chu 'bab pa 'og tu 'gyur ba dang*/ rtswa shing sogs gcod pa dang*/ mer 'debs pa sogs rang ngam bskos pas brtsams te srog chags ji snyed shi ba de snyed kyi ltung ba'o// chu tshags med par ljongs rgyur mi 'gro zhing*/

chu tshags la lnga ste/ dpyangs tshags/ bum tshags gce'u can/ gru gsum tshags/ ril ba zhabs tshags cag /bsal tshags dang ngo*/ chu rung ba lnga ste/ dge 'dun dang gang zag dang*/ chu rung ba dang*/ yid ches pa dang*/ brtags te'o// nyal po byed shom na 'dug pa dang*/ rten bsam pa ni yang*/ gzhi sbyor ni nyal zhes te/ bar chad dang rkyen dang mi ldan bzhin du skyes pa bud med 'khrig par zhugs pa'am phyogs pa la/ gnas gcig tu sbyor ba mngon sum du brnogs te 'dug nas de dag gis tshor ba ltung ba'o// nyal shom nas 'greng ba dang*/ rten bsam ni yang dang*/ yul sbyor ni nyal zhes (41na)te/ khyad par ni 'greng ba ste snga ma bzhin no// gcer bu pa la sbyin pa'i rten yul ni yang*/ sbyor ba ni rang gi zhes te/ gcer bu pa pho mo gang rung nye du'am/ nad pa'am/ dge ba la sbyor ba'i don min par dus rung gi zas rang dang de gnyis kas za rung lag gis ster nas des thob na ltung ba'o// dmag la lta ba la rten gzhi yang*/ sbyor ba ltar zhes te/ rkyen dang mi ldan pa'i dge slong gis khyim pa'i dmag mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'thab pa'am 'thab tu bcug pa rgyal po sogs kyis bkug pa min par kun slong lta 'dod kyis gnas nye 'khor dang bcas pa 'das te blta bar brtsams nas mthong na ltung ba'o// dmag gi nang na gnas pa'i rten gnang tshad ni yang*/ 'das pa ni de la zhes te/ gnas dmag nang du rgyal po sogs kyis bkug pa ma yin par mtshan mo gnyis las 'das te/ skya rengs shar ba na ltung ba'o// dgos pa med na zhag gcig kyang ltung ba'o// dpung gi yan lag nyams su myong bar 'dod pa la/ rten gnang ba'i dus ni dge slong*/ sbyor ba mthar thug ni yang zhes te/ dpung gi yan lag myang 'dod kyis sbyor ba reg pa'am/ dkrugs par brtsams te g.yul bsham dkrug gi bya ba rdzogs na ltung ba'o// skyes pa bud med gla nga po sogs 'thab 'jug lta ba sogs la nyes byas so// brdeg pa la rten bsam pa ni yang*/

yul sbyor ni dge slong zhes so// yul dge slong pha rol po la phan pa'i don min par lus sam des 'phangs pa'am/ de dang 'brel ba dbyug pa sogs yungs kar tsam gyis kyang rnyog pa can gyi (41ba)bsam pas brdeg par brtsams te/ brdeg spyad re la ltung ba re'o// bdag nyid kyi lus dang ka ba rtsig pa sogs la brdeg na nyes byas so// brdeg par gzas la rten bsam pa ni/ yang dang yul sbyor ni/ dge slong zhes te/ khyad par ni brdeg par gzas pa ste/ gzhan snga ma bzhin no// gnas ngan len 'chab pa la rten bsam pa ni yang*/ yul sbyor ba ni dge slong zhes te/ yul dge slong sdom pa gso rung yan chad kyi pham lhag gi ltung ba kun slong dge slong bde bar mi reg pa dang*/ dge sbyong gi tshul lam/ srog gam/ tshangs spyod kyi bar chad dam/ dge 'dun 'khrugs dogs kyi bsam pa min par 'chab 'dod kyis mtshan mo 'das na ltung ba'o// pham lhag las gzhan pa'i rang gzhan gyi nyes pa 'chab na nyes byas so// sdom la/ bde dang me dang 'dun pa dang*/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs chos smra dang*/ dge tshul kha dog bsgyur ba dang*/ rin po che dang tsha ba'i dus// zhes pas zan gcod 'jug la rten ched yang*/ yul las 'tsho ba bsgrub pa ni dge slong*/ rjes su bsgrub pa'i sbyor ba ni de zhes te/ bsnyung bas phan pa'i nad can min pa'i dge slong la sbyin bdag gis dus rung zas rung ba la sbyor ba na zan gcod tshig gis yul gyi zan rang gling gi nyi ma yol nas ltung ba'o// sman gzhan la nyes byas so// me la reg pa ni rten ched ni yang*/ gzhi sbyor ni me la zhes te/ dkon mchog dang tshangs spyod chos ldan gyi don dang*/ tshon sogs dus byin rlabs ma gtogs par sbyor ba rang ngam gzhan bskos te me la reg pa (42na)dang*/ spar gsod sogs byed na ltung ba'o// seng ge sogs gtum po la mi reg cing*/ dus dran ni dkon mchog sogs kyi phyir ston pas gnang ngo snyam du bsam ste bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar yid la bya'o// 'dun pa phyir bsgyur ni/

rten gzhi yang kun slong sbyor ba de'i zhes te/ dge 'dun gyi chos ldan gyi las mtshan nyid pa la rang gis 'dun pa phul ba/ kun slong 'dun pa phyir bsgyur 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba bdag 'dun pa mi phul gyi phyir 'on cig ces pa'i tshig gi don go ba na ltung ba'o// bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig tu nyal ba la/ rten yul ni yang dang*/ sbyor ba ni/ lhan cig ces te/ rten na ba dang nad g.yog min pa'i dge slong gis dge slong sdig can dang*/ nye bar gnas pa dang*/ dge tshul lam gyis dub pa sogs kyi rkyen med par ma rdzogs pa dang gnas cig tu nyal 'dod kyi bsam pas/ mtshams gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa 'dom phyed dgu'i nang rol tu nub gsum bstud mar rang dang ma rdzogs pa gnyis ka nyal zhing spyod lam des nub gsum pa'i skya rengs dang po shar na ltung ba'o// zla nyi'i snang ba las gzhan pa'i mar me dang nor bu'i snang bar rkyen dang mi ldan pas nyal bar mi bya'o// sdig lta mi gtong ba la/ gang la gzham bsgo bya ba ni yang zhes dang*/ byed pa gang gis bzlog pa ni dge slong zhes dang*/ ji ltar bzlog pa ni 'di skad gsol zhing bzlog pa ni dge slong 'das pa ni lan gnyis lan gsum zhes te/ dge slong gis chang btung ba lta bu bcom ldan 'das kyis mtho ris dang thar pa'i bar chad du 'gyur bar bstan pa de (42ba)bsten kyang mtho ris dang thar pa'i bar chad du mi 'gyur zhes pa lta bu 'du shes ma 'khrul bar rlom zhing kun slong skur 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyor ba der zhugs tshe dge 'dun gyi gzham bsgo dang gsol bzhis bzlog kyang brjod pa gsum pa la mi gtong ba ltung ba'o// spangs pa rjes phyogs ni rten bsam pa yang*/ gzhi sbyor ni de skad ces te/ dge slong sdig lta can bzod pa ma gsol ba dge 'dun gyis gnas nas phyung ba/ kun slong de dang lhan cig gtam 'dri ba dang*/ nyal 'dod kyi bsam pas/

sbyor ba na ba dang chos ldan ma gtogs der lhan cig gtam 'dri bar brtsam ste mthar thug mtshan mo de'i skad cig ma 'das pa na ltung ba'o// bsnyil ba sdud pa las/ gang la gzham bsgo bya ba ni dge tshul/ gsol bzhis bzlog pa ni dge tshul/ rten bsam pa ni yang yul sbyor ni de ltar shes te/ khyad par ni dge tshul sdig lta can bzod pa ma gsol ba ste gzhan snga ma bzhin no// kha ma bsgyur ba gyon pa la/ rten kha dog gi rung ba ni dge slong gzhi sbyor ni gal te zhes te/ dge slong gis chu tshags ma gtogs lhung bzed kha g.yogs dang rkang dkris tsam gyi gos dkar po la longs spyad na ltung ba'o// tshos chen brgyad kyis bsgyur ba la yang nyes byas te/ sum brgya par/ mtshal dang de bzhin rgya ska ga btsod rnams dang*// gur gum dang ni mthing shun li khri dang*// rma na shing leb brgan rtsi rnams mi rung ste// brgyad po tshos chen yin pas bkag phyir ro// rin po che'i gdags gzhir longs pa gzhir gtogs la rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal ni dang*/ bslab bya ni dge slong zhes (43na)te/ chud 'dza' ba'i rkyen med cing*/ sbyin bdag gi bsod nams 'dod pas bstab pa'am/ mi min gyi gnas lta bu min par/ rang gis dbang ba'i rin po che'am/ rin po cher smos pa go mtshon dang rol cha sogs la rgod bag gis reg 'dod kyi bsam pas/ dngos sam bskos nas reg na ltung ba'o// khrus byed pa la/ ltung ba dmigs bsal ni bcom ldan 'das/ gnang dus ni de las zhes te/ khrus kyis phan pa'i nad dang dkon mchog gi phyir ba mal tsam gyi phyag bdar dang*/ dpag tshad phyed du phyin pa min pa'i dge slong gis/ dus zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gcig nas bdun pa'i bco lnga'i bar ma gtogs par rkyen dang mi ldan pas zla ba phyed phyed kyi nang du khrus byed par brtsams te dus min par lus ril khrus byed na ltung ba'o// lus la char thig gnyis phog pa'am/

gos kyi grwa bskyod pa'i rlung phog pa yan la ltung ba 'di med/ sdom la/ dud 'gro 'gyod pa sor mo dang*/ rtse dang lhan cig snga ngas byed dang*/ sbed dang gding med gzhi med dang*/ skyes pa med par lam 'gro ba'o// de la dud 'gro gsod pa ni rten bsam ni yang*/ gzhi sbyor ni dud 'gro zhes te/ dud 'gror gtogs pa'i srog chags mig lam du snang rung 'du shes ma 'khrul pa'am/ yid gnyis za bas kun slong gsod 'dod kyis/ sbyor ba rang ngam bskos pas gsod par brtsams te rkyen des shi na ji snyed kyi ltung ba'o// gsod sems med par yan lag gcod pa dang*/ brdeg 'tshog gzugs brnyan 'jig pa sogs la nyes byas so// 'gyod pa bskyed pa las rten bsam pa yang dge slong*/ (43ba)yul ched ces nas/ sbyor ba ni 'gyod ces te/ dge slong pha rol po la kun slong yid mi bde ba skye 'dod kyi bsam pas bzhad gad yan gyis khyod la sdom pa ma skyes so// skyes kyang pham pa byung zhes sogs kyis 'gyod pa bskyed de don go ba na ltung ba'o// gag tshil ni sor mo zhes te/ dge slong pha rol po la skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas su skyi g.ya' bar bsam pas sbyor ba brtsams te skyi g.ya' bar byas pa'i reg bya re re la ltung ba re re'o// chu la rtse ba la chu la zhes te 'jig rten na grags pa'i chu la rgod bag gis rang ngam bskos pas rtses te lte ba nub pa'i tshad du zhugs na ltung ba'o// bud med dang lhan cig nyal ba rten yul ni yang*/ sbyor ba ni lhan cig ces te/ bud med nye du min par rten rung*/ gnas gcig tu mtshams chod na 'dom gang gi nang*/ mtshams ma chod na 'dom dgu'i nang du gnyis ka nyal 'dod kyi bsam pas khrims grogs med par mtshan mo'i mtha' rdzogs pa na ltung ba'o// snga ngas par byed pa la/ rten yul ni yang*/ sbyor ba ni sngags zhes te/ dge slong pha rol po la 'jigs rgyu yid du mi 'ong pa sha za sogs 'dod yon lngas bzhad gad yan gyis 'jigs pa bstan te skrag pa skyes na ltung ba'o// yid 'ong gis snga ngas na nyes byas/

nges 'byung gi phyir dmyal ba sogs brjod pa la nyes pa med do// sbed pa la/ rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor dmigs ni/ sbed dam zhes sogs te rab byung sde lnga'i lhung bzed sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad chud za ba'i rkyen med par kun slong rku sems dang phan 'dod las gzhan pas rang ngam/ bskos pas brtsams te sbas zin na ltung ba'o// (44na)gding med du spyod pa ni/ rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor ba ni de'i 'og ces te/ dge slong rang dang nor mi gcig pa la rku sems med cing des gnang ba'i gding med par longs spyad na ltung ba/ gos las gzhan pa'i yo byad la nyes byas/ longs spyad pas dga' bar 'gyur na ltung ba med do// lhag mas skur 'debs la rten bsam ni yang*/ yul ni dge slong*/ sbyor ba dge 'dun zhes te/ dge slong pha rol po la mthong thos dogs pa'i gzhi med par nyams par 'dod pas 'du shes bsgyur te kun slong skur 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sbyor ba ming nas bzung ste lhag mas skur pa btab pa'i don go ba na ltung ba'o// bud med dang lhan cig lam 'gro ni/ rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor ba ni lhan cig ces te/ bud med lus bsten rung*/ nye du min pa/ khrims grogs med par lhan cig rgyang grags 'das pa na ltung ba'o// de'i phyed la nyes byas so// bud med kyis lam bsrel byed pa sogs la nyes pa med do// sdom la/ rku dang nyi shu ma lon dang*// brko dang mgron dang bslab pa dang*// 'thab dang mi smra 'gro ba dang*// ma gus chang 'thung dus min pa'o// rkun ma dang lhan cig lam 'gro ni/ rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor ba ni 'gro na zhes te/ grong 'joms pa dang*/ sho gam dral ba'i chom rkun dang lhan cig rgyang grags las 'das par 'gro ba na ltung ba re re'o// nyi shu ma lon par rdzogs pa ni/ rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor ba ni dge slong*/ nyes dmigs ni gang zag de yang zhes te/

mngal shol brtsis pas nyi shu ma lon par 'du shes (44ba)sam/ the tshom za bas kun slong rang gar mkhan 'dod kyi sbyor ba brtsams te/ mthar thug brjod pa gsum pa'i byed pa brjod pa'i mgo brtsams pa'i tshe mkhan po la ltung byed/ slon dpon dang dge 'dun la nyes byas so// mngal shol gyis nyi shu ma lon kyang bsgrub byas lon par 'du shes nas skye ba'i bar chad gzhan med cing skye ba'i rkyen gzhan tshogs na bsam pa'i sgo nas nar son pas bsnyen rdzogs chags shing*/ de rdzogs pa'i rjes la mngal shol dang bcas kyang nyi shu ma lon 'dug na de'i rdzogs pa'i sdom pa 'jig ste lus bsam gang nas kyang nar ma son pas sdom pa'i rten nyams pa'i phyir/ ma lon kyang lon par 'du shes pa la bsnyen rdzogs chags na mngal shol dang bcas pas nyi shu lon na len dus nyi shu ma lon 'dug snyam du shes kyang sdom pa mi 'jig ste/ skyes shing btang rgyu gzhan ma byung na lus kyi nar son cing sdom pa'i rten yin pa'i phyir/ skyes nas nyi shu ma lon kyang mngal shol dang bcas pa lon na bsnyen rdzogs chags la/ mkhan slob dge 'dun la nyes pa bskyed/ nyi shu lon pa la ma lon par 'du shes kyang sdom pa'i rten du rung ngo*// dge tshul lo bdun ma lon kyang mnga' shol dang bcas pas lon na skye la nyes byas yin no// sa brko ba dang*/ rten gzhi ni yang zhes dang*/ sbyor ba ni brko zhes te/ na ba sogs kyi rkyen med par grags pa'i sa 'thas pa/ rang ngam bskos pas sor bzhi yan chad bskos na ltung ba'o// sa nyams pa dang bye ma sogs la nyes byas so// mgron du bos pa las ring du bsdad (45na)pa la/ rten gnang ba'i tshad ni dge slong*/ 'das pa ni de las/ gnang dus bye brag ni so sor zhes te/ rkyen dang mi ldan par sbyin bdag gis dus ji tsam mgron du bos pa las ring du 'dug ste/ za 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyin bdag gis ci tsam 'dod gyi bar bzhugs zhes pa lta bu med par mgron rdzogs pa'i 'og tu yang za bar brtsam ste mgul du mid pa la ltung ba'o// bslab pa nyer 'jog spong ba ni rten khyad gsod kyi dus ni yang*/

sbyor ba ni de dag ces te dge slong pha rol po 'dul bar gtogs pa'i bslab bya bslab bo zhes pa na ma 'khrul zhing kun slong bsgyur te mi slob pa smra 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sbyor ba bslab pa nyer 'jog po la khyod kyis mi shes te gzhan la 'dri yi/ de'i bar bslab pa 'di la mi slob ces smra ba brtsams te don go na ltung ba'o// nyan rna las gyur pa la rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor ba phyed ni dge slong zhes te/ pha rol po rtsod zlar gyur pa dag rtsod pa gzhi las gang rung byed pa na nor ba dang rtsod pa zhi 'dod min pas dkrugs pa'i ched du nyan 'dod kyi bsam pas rna ba gtod nas don go ba na ltung ba'o// don ma go na nyes byas/ grogs sogs kyi sar 'gro ba na se gol gyi brda byed/ mi smra ba 'gro ba la rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal ni cang mi smra zhes te/ dge slong kha skong bar 'os pas dge 'dun gyi nang du las la 'dus pa na gsol ba tsam gyi las ma byas par gnas de nas dge slong 'khod pa la ma smras par 'gro ba brtsams te/ las thos pa'i nye 'khor 'das par phyin pa na ltung ba'o// ma gus pa la/ (45ba)gus par mi byed na zhes te/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang*/ dge 'dun gyi zhal ta ba chos ldan gyis bsgo ba rang gis bsgrub pa la 'gal ba byed 'dod kyis sbyor ba gzhig 'grel ma byas par 'gal bar byas na ltung ba'o// mkhan slob/ rgyal po/ dgra bcom/ gnas brtan gyi bka' bcag na nyes byas so// myos 'gyur 'thung ba ni/ gzhi ni 'bru'i chang*/ sbyor ba 'thung na zhes te/ phab btab pa 'bru'i chang dang*/ ma btab pa rgun sogs btsos pa'i chang dngos sam/ spang tshig la sogs myos pa'i nus can longs spyod par brtsams te// mgul du mid pa na ltung ba'o// myos pa'i nus pa med par dri bro ba dang*/ lus min pa kha bshal ba dang*/ lus la bskud pa sogs la nyes byas/ nad pas mi mid par kha bshal ba dang lus la bskud pa tsam la nyes pa med cing*/

chang bskol ba la nyes med du gsungs pa ni ro nus med pa la dgongs pa'o// dus min par 'gro ba la/ rten bkag pa'i dus yang*/ sbyor ba dmigs bsal grong du 'jug ces te/ sra brkyang ma bting zhing bar chad kyi rkyen dang mi ldan pa'i dge slong gnas na 'khod pa'i rab tu byung ba la ma smras par gnas de nas khyim pa'i gnas su nyi ma phyed yol nas skya rengs ma shar gyi bar du 'du shes dus min la/ der shes pa'i the tshom za bas sbyor ba brtsams te rang gnas nye 'khor las 'das na ltung ba'o// sdom la/ zas bcas skya rengs da gdod dang*// khab ral dang ni khri rkang dang*// gdal dang gdan dang g.yan dgab dang*// ras chen bder gshegs chos gos so// zhes pa'i dang po zas bcas la yang zhes te/ (46na)'di la snga dro grong rgyu dang phyi dro grong rgyu gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rten dge slong de'i tshig gis dge 'dun rnams sbyin bdag khyim pa yin pa'i khyim du zas la spyan drang pa na sbyin bdag la dus ma yol bar brims zhes ma bsgo bar grong du rgyu 'dod kyi bsam pa rkyen dang mi ldan par grong gzhan du sbyor ba 'gro bar brtsams te grong gsum pa la sogs par rgyus pa na ltung ba'o// gnyis pa'i dbang du byas na/ dge slong 'khod pa la smras kyang nyin phyed yol nas skya rengs tha ma ma shar bar khyim bzhi sogs su 'gro na ltung ba'o// rgyal po'i pho brang du nub mo 'gro ba la rten bkag pa'i dus ni yang*/ gzhi mthar thug ni rgyal po zhes te/ rgyal po sogs chos ldan gyi don la bos pa dang*/ dgos pa khyad par can dang*/ rkyen gzhan dang mi ldan par rgyal po'i pho brang dang btsun mo'i gnas su dmar thag chod nas skya rengs ma shar gyi bar der 'du shes sam/ yid gnyis za bar sbyor bas brtsams te/ de'i sgo bcad na gtan pa'i gnas dang*/ ma bcad na gtan pa gnyis 'gyur ba'i slar sleb na ltung ba'o// bslab gzhi khyad gsod la/

rten khyad du gsod pa'i dus ni yang*/ sbyor ba ni 'di skad ces te/ so thar gyi mdo lan gnyis yan chad thos pa'i dge slong gis gso sbyong gi dus su bzhad bgad yan gyis bslab gzhi khyad gsod kyi tshig smras te mthar 'dul bar gtogs pa'i bslab pa khyad du gsod na ltung ba'o// khab ral 'chos pa'i rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor ba dmigs gsal ni byed dam sogs phyir bcos ni bcag nas zhes te/ ba so dang rus pa (46ba)dang rwa dang rin po che yul dus der dkon cing rin che ba'i rgyu las khab ral bcos te zin pa na ltung ba'o// ltung ba 'di bshags dus khab ral bcag gam zhes 'dri'o// khri rkang 'chos pa la/ rten gnang tshad ni yang*/ 'das pa ni de las te/ dge 'dun gyi khri'am khri'u rkang pa bu gar gzhug pa yan chad khru gang tshad yin la/ de las lhag pa sbyor ba rang ngam bskos pas brtsams te mthar thug lhag po zin na ltung ba/ gang zag gi dad mol che mtho la 'dug na nyes byas so// khri rkang gding ba g.yan dgab ras chen tshad lhag bzhi bshags pa'i tshe bshags yul gyis bcad dam zhes ma dris na nyes byas so// shing bal gyis gos par byas pa la rten gzhi ni yang*/ sbyor ba ni bdal lam/ phyis bcos ni bsdus nas zhes te/ dge 'dun gyi gnas mal shing bal gyis sbyor ba rang ngam bskos pas mthar gos par byed na ltung ba'o// gang zag gi la nyes byas so// 'di bshags dus shing bal bsdu dgos so// gding ba la rten gnang tshad dge slong*/ 'das pa phyir bcos ni de las te/ gding tshad srid khru gsum/ zhes khru do dang sor drug srid du mi chog na khru phyed do bskyed do// g.yan dgab la rten yang dge slong gis/ 'das pa phyir bcos ni de las zhes te/ de'i srid khru drug zheng khru gsum/ ras chen la rten gnang tshad dge slong gis/ 'das pa ni de las zhes te/ de'i tshad srid khru dgu/ zheng khru gsum dang sor bco brgyad/

bde gshegs chos gos kyi tshad gyur la rten sbyor ba ni yang dge slong*/ gnang ba'i tshad ni de las (47na)zhes te/ ston pa'i bla gos dang snam sbyar gyi tshad ni srid du ston pa rang gi khru lnga/ zheng du khru gsum/ ston pa'i khru re re la mi 'bring po'i khru gsum yin pas ston pa'i chos gos gcig la mi 'bring po'i chos gos dgu 'gyur ro// des na ston pa'i sku lus tsam med par de'i chos gos kyi tshad tsam mam/ de las lhag par sbyor ba brtsams te zin na ltung ba'o// 'don pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa zhes dang*/ rnam gzhag bsgrags pa ni de la zhes so// so sor bshags pa la/ sgro skur spangs don du/ sdom la/ grong dang khyim gzhan gnyid dang ni// bslab pa dang ni dgon pa ste// sangs rgyas phan pa gsungs pa yis// so sor bshags pa bya bar gsung*// zhes bstan nas 'don pa'i lung 'bog pa ni tshe dang ldan pa zhes so// dge slong ma las za ma len pa'i so sor bshags pa ni rten yul yang*/ dngos sbyor phyir bcos rang zhes te/ dge slong ma nye du min pas zas blang ba de sbyor ba rang dang dge slong ma gnyis ka grong ngam lam po che na 'dug ste des de la zas blangs te zos pa na sor bshags dang po'o// gral rim du ma pheb par 'brim du 'jug pa ma bzlog par za ba la rten gzhi ni dge slong*/ sbyor ba phyir bcos ni de skad ces te/ sbyin bdag khyim pas dge 'dun gdugs tshod kyi phyir spyan drangs pa na/ dge slong mas bsgo bshams kyis ngos mgron byas pa la/ dge slong gis sring mo khyod dge slong rnams zas zos zin gyi bar du re zhig ma bsgo bar sdod cig ces ma bsgo bar bsgo bshams (47ba)byas pa za 'dod kyi bsam sbyor gyis mthar thug mgul du mid pa na ltung ba'o// bslab pa dral te khyim du 'jug pa la rten gzhi ni bslab pa dag /sbyor ba phyir bcos ni rang gis shes te/

de yang bslab pa'i sdom pa byin pa'i khyim du ma bos par bslab pa'i sdom pa bcas pa la gtogs pa'i dge slong gis khyim du zas 'dod kyi bsam sbyor gyis mthar thug bza' bca' mgul du mid pa na ltung ba'o// nags ma brtags pa las gyur pa la/ rten yul ni dge 'dun/ sbyor ba phyir bcos ni bslangs te/ de ci ltar dag par bya ba ni dge slong de zhes sogs te/ ltung ba 'di bzhi ni lto 'dun las gyur pa dge 'dun gyi kun rar smre sngags kyi sgo nas bshags dgos pa dge slong de zhes sogs kyi 'don pa 'di ni sor bshags bzhi ka'i mthar sbyar la/ rten dge slong gis nags nyul bar bskos pa na 'jigs bcas kyi nags ma nyul bar/ khyim pa nye du min pa las zas bslangs te/ nags ma nyul bar shes bzhin du mthar thug mgul du mid pa na so sor bshags pa'o// 'don pa bsdu ba ni tshe dang ldan pa zhes pa dang*/ rnam gzhag bsgrags pa ni de la zhes so// nyes byas kyi sde las sgro skur spang pa ni/ sdom la/ sham thabs la ni rnam bdun dang*// stod g.yogs la yang rnam gsum dang*// shin tu bsdams pa la sogs lnga// mgo g.yogs la sogs rnam pa lnga// mchongs la sogs pa rnam lnga dang*// lus la sogs pa rnam pa lnga// 'dug par bya ba dgu dag dang*// byin len bya ba brgyad rnams so// zhes pa'o// (48na)'don pa'i ched du lung 'bogs pa ni/ tshe dang ldan pa zhes so// de la gos bsgo ba'i sde ni/ sham thabs zlum por bsgo bar bya'o// pus gong du rtsengs pa ma yin pa/ long bur 'jol ba ma yin pa/ sta zur gyi thad kar gla nga po che'i sna ltar nar ba ma yin pa/ ta la'i lo ma ltar ska rag gi gong su lteb pa ma yin pa/ 'bru'i phur ma ltar rag yar mar gyi bar du thum por 'ong ba ma yin pa/ sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka ltar ska rags kyi sne nas kha phyir gdengs pa ma yin pa'o// chos gos la steng 'og gi mtha' zlum por bsgo zhing rtsengs 'jol ma yin pa'o// lam 'jug gi sde la/

lus sems shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas bsdams shing gos kyis lus khyab par bsgo ba dang*/ sgra bskyung ba dang*/ mig g.yeng ba mig gi rdzi ma btsum par mi lta ba dang*/ gnya' shing gang tsam du blta zhing 'gro ba'o// mgo gos kyis mi g.yogs pa dang*/ gos mi brdze/ gos phrag pa gnyis su mi gzar/ lag pa g.yas g.yon mdun gyi phyogs su mi bsnol/ de bskyur nas ltag par mi bsnol/ mi mchongs/ rkang pa mi brkyang*/ rkang pa mnyam du tsog pur mi spo/ rkang pa yi brang pa kho nas mi 'gro/ dkur lag sor gtad nas gru mo snyung snyung du mi 'gro/ lus mi bsgyur/ lag pa mi dkyog /mgo mi bsgyur/ gnyis phrag pa mi sprad/ gnyis lag pa mi sbrel ba khyim du 'gro ba la bslab par bya'o// stan la 'dug pa'i sde la/ gzhan gyis ma bsgo bar stan la mi 'dug (48ba)rang gis ma brtag par mi 'dug /lus kyi ljid phab ste mi 'dug /rkang pa brkyang ste mi bsnol/ brla mi bsnol/ long bu'i steng du long bu mi bzhag /rkang pa khri 'og tu mi dgug /thad gar mi gdangs/ 'doms sba bar bya'o// zas bslang ba'i sde ni/ 'dul ba dang 'jig rten gnyis dang mi 'gal bar legs par zas blang bar bya'o// lhung bzed kyi mu dang kha da chad du ma yin pa/ tshod ma dang 'bras mnyam pa ma yin pa/ rgan rim mthar chags su len pa dang*/ lhung bzed la blta zhing len pa dang*/ bza' bca' ma 'ongs par lhung bzed mi bzed pa dang*/ tshod ma 'dod pas 'bras chen mi dgab cing*/ 'bras chen 'dod pas tshod ma mi dgab/ bza' bca'i steng du lhung bzed mi bzung bar bslab par bya'o// zas bza' ba'i sde ni/ sdom la/ zas la legs par bya ba drug /tsug tsug la sogs rnam pa lnga// 'bru nas tha dad byed pa lnga// lag pa bldag la sogs pa lnga// zhes 'jig rten dang 'dul ba mi 'gal bar legs par zas bza' ba dang*/ kham ha cang chung ba ma yin/ ches pa min pa/ kham ran pa/ kham ma gzas par kha mi gdangs/

kha bkang ste mi smra bar bslab par bya'o// tsug tsug dang*/ cag cag dang*/ hu hu dang*/ phu phu dang*/ lce phyung ste bza' bar mi bya'o// 'bru re re nas mi bza'/ 'phyas mi gdags// mkhur bar mi spo/ rkan mi tog /kham 'phro mi bcad par bza' bar bya'o// zas kyis 'bags pa'i lag pa mi bldag /lhung bzed mi 'byog (49na)lag pa mi sprug /lhung bzed du zas mi skyom/ zas la mchod rten 'dra ba bcos te mi za bar bslab par bya'o// lhung bzed spyad pa la sogs pa'i sde rnams ni/ sdom la/ 'phya la sogs pa rnam pa bzhi// lhung bzed la yang rnam pa bcu// 'greng ba byed la sogs pa lnga// mgo g.yog la sogs rnam pa lnga// do ker can la sogs pa lnga// gla nga chen la sogs zhon pa lnga// lag na mkhar ba la sogs drug /na ba rnam pa bzhi rnams so// zhes pa las drung na 'dug pa'i dge slong gi lhung bzed la 'phya phyir mi blta/ 'bags pas lhung bzed mi bzung*/ drung na 'dug pa'i dge slong la zas dang 'bags pa'i chus mi gtong bar bslab par bya/ sbyin bdag la ma dris par 'bags chu mi dbo/ lhung bzed du zas kyi lhag ma blug ste mi 'dor/ chu gtsang mas lhung bzed lan gsum bkrus te gtsug lag gi tshigs su bcad pas chu sbyin du bya/ 'og gzhi med pa'i phyogs su mi bzhag /gad kha dang*/ g.yang sa dang*/ bkan sar mi bzhag /'greng ste mi bkru/ gad ka ma yin pa dang*/ g.yang sa ma yin pa dang*/ dkan gzar po ma yin par lhung bzed bkru bar bslab par bya/ rgyun las bzlog ste mi gcu/ lam mdor mi bzhag /chos bshad pa'i sde ni/ 'dug pa la 'greng ste dang*/ nyal ba la 'dug ste dang*/ stan mthon po la dma' ba dang*/ mdun du 'gro ba la phyi nas dang*/ lam du 'gro ba la lam 'gram nas chos mi bshad de/ na ba ni ma gtogs so// mgo g.yogs pa dang*/ brdzes pa dang*/ gzar ba dang*/ gnya' gong du bsnol ba dang*/ ltag par bsnol ba la na ba ma gtogs te chos mi ston/

skra do ker can dang*/ zhwa dang*/ cod pan dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ mgo dkris pa la na ba ma gtogs (49ba)te chos mi ston/ gla nga bo che dang*/ rta dang*/ khyogs dang*/ bzhon pa'i steng na ste shing rta sogs dang*/ mchil lh+wam gyon pa la na ba ma gtogs chos mi ston/ mkhar ba dang*/ gdugs dang*/ mtshon dang*/ ral gri dang*/ dgra cha thogs pa dang*/ go cha gyon pa la na ba ma gtogs chos mi ston/ sgrub pa'i sde ni/ 'greng ba dang*/ chu dang*/ rtswa sngon gyi phyogs su gshang gci mchil snabs skyugs rlugs na ba'i rkyen gyis ma gtogs te mi 'dor/ rgyu ba dgag pa'i sde ni/ gnod pa 'byung ba ma gtogs shing la mi gang gis mtho bar mi 'dzeg par bslab bo// 'don pa bsdu ba ni tshe dang ldan pa zhes so// rnam gzhag bsgrags pa ni de la zhes sogs so// da ni so sor thar pa'i mdor bslab pa yongs sbyongs kyi gzhi dang*/ bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen gyi gzhi ma smros kyang 'dir kha bska ngas nas 'don pa la/ dang po yongs sbyong gi gzhi la/ gso sbyong*// dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye ste gsum las/ dang po gso sbyong gi don ni/ bslab pa gsum dag gso zhing sbyong bar byed pa ste/ mthun pa'i gso sbyong dang*/ zhi gnas kyi gso sbyong gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gso zhing sbyong bar byed la/ phyi mas ni bslab pa zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin gso zhing sbyong bar byed la/ de gnyis kas kyang brgyud nas lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gso zhing sbyong bar byed la/ mthun pa'i gso sbyong de la yang bcu bzhi pa dang*/ bco lnga pa dang*/ bkra shis kyi dang*/ gnod pa bzlog pa'i dang*/ bsdum pa'i gso sbyong ste lnga las/ bkra shis (50na)kyi ni rung ba min pa'i gzhi bcu sel ba dang*/ rab gnas sogs kyi dus su'o// gnod pa'i dus kyi ni nad yams sogs zhi ba'i ched du'o// bsdum pa'i phyir ni dge 'dun gyi rtsod pa la sogs pa zhi ba'i ched du'o// bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa ni zla ba phyed phyed cing brgyud bcas rang gis dag par khas len pa'i don du ste/

be sha ka las/ gso sbyong zla phyed re re yis// sdig rnams yongs su dag phyir ro// zhes so// de las zla ba phyed phyed cing gso sbyong byed dgos pa la/ 'dul ba la lo lnga nas zla theb re 'don pa'i dbang du byas nas/ lo gcig la zhag mi thub pa drug 'byung ba'i dus ni gso sbyong bcu bzhi par 'jog la/ de yang lo gcig la dus tshigs drug gi dbang du byas shing*/ de re re la yang zla ba gnyis gnyis kyi dbang du byas nas/ spyi ldog dus tshigs gsum du bcad pa'i dgun dpyid dbyar zla ba bzhi bzhir byas pa la dgun dpyid dbyar gsum po re re zhing stod smad gnyis su byas te/ nang gses zla ba gnyis gnyis su byas pa'i don la/ mdzod las/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi// zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das shing*// zla ba phyed ni lus pa na// mkhas pas zhag mi thub par 'dor// zhes dang*/ be sha ka las/ kha ba sogs ka dbyar rnams kyi// zla ba gnyis dang bzhi yi ni// mar ngo la ni bcu bzhi yi// gso sbyong sdom brtson dag gis bya// sa ga dang ni chu stod dang*// de bzhin khrums smad smin drug dang*// rgyal dang dbo zhes bya (50ba)ba nyid// drug po'i mar ngo bcu bzhir brjod// ces gsungs la/ skabs 'dir mgo rgyal mchu gsum gyis nya ba ni hor bcu gcig pa bcu gnyis pa dang po ste dgun rab 'bring tha gsum/ dbo nag pa sa ga gsum gyis nya ba ni hor zla gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa ste dpyid rab 'bring tha gsum/ snron chu stod gro bzhin gsum ni hor zla lnga pa drug pa bdun pa gsum ste dbyar rab 'bring tha gsum/ khrums tha ska ra ram dbyug pa smin drug ste/ hor zla brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa ni ston rab 'bring tha gsum las/ lo dri ba dang*/ thub pa dgongs rgyan las/ dbyar dgun 'bring zhag mi thub dang*// ston dpyid 'bring zhag thub tu gsungs pa dang*// 'dul ba kun btus dang 'grel chung sogs las/

dbyar dgun 'bring zhag thub dang*/ ston dpyid 'bring zhag mi thub tu gsungs pa rnams mi 'gal te/ snga ma ni mar ngo sngon 'gro'i dbang du byas pa dang*/ phyi ma ni yar ngo sngon 'gro'i dbang du byas pa'o// shol 'byung ba'i zla ba de'i mar ngo'i zhag thub tu byed mi byed la lugs gnyis las/ kha cig mi thub pa'i rjes su shol byung na mi thub pa/ thub pa'i rjes su shol byung na thub pa de ltar byas nas/ mthar sa ga dang ni chu stod dang*// zhes sogs kyi gso sbyong gi dus mi 'chugs par smra ba dang*/ kha cig /shol zla thams cad zhag thub tu bya dgos te/ lo re re zhing zhag mi thub drug drug 'dor ba de nyid kyis zla shol gyi zhag mi thub 'dor ba song ba yin gyi/ de ltar min na ha cang thal ches zer ro// de ltar gyi tshe (51na)dgun dang kha ba zhes pas lo'i 'dor ba de nyid kyi mgo dgun nas ngos 'dzin pa la dgun zla dang po'i 'jog mtshams la mi 'grigs pa sna tshogs par yod par grags pa las/ kha cig mdo sde nyi snying las/ zla rangs nya tshes tha ska ra yin// ston zla 'bring po'i ngo la ni// lo skor bdag gis brjod par bya// zla ba bcu gnyis bshad pa yin// zhes tha ska ra gyi nya ba hor zla dgu pa'i bco lnga nas lo rdzogs nas de'i bcu drug nas lo mgo 'dzin pa'i lugs shig yod la/ mdzod las/ dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi// tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring*// dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la// thung dur 'gyur ro nyin mo bzlog /ces dang*/ de'i 'grel bshad du/ dbyar zla ba bzhi ni/ dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya nas ston zla tha chung gi nya'i bar bzhi la bzhag la// de'i tshes sa ga zla ba'i bcu drug nas snron zla ba'i bco lnga'i bar ni dbyar zla ra ba bar 'jog la/ de dbyar zla dang po dang*/ snron zla ba'i bcu drug nas chu stod kyi bco lnga'i bar ni de'i zla ba gnyis par 'jog la/ de'i gnyis pa'i tha ma'i tshes dgu ni hor zla drug pa'i nyi shu tsam la dbyar nyi ldog pas/

deng sang gi nyi ma ldog mtshams dang yang 'grigs pas/ hor zla brgyad pa khrums kyis nya ba'i phyi de nyin nas lo mgo 'dzin pa'i lugs gcig dang*/ de ltar kyi tshe dbyar dang po'i khas len zla ba bzhi pa la byed dgos shing*/ yang hor zla bcu pa smin drug gi nya ba'i phyi de nyin par nas mgo 'dzin pa'i lugs dang gsum las/ (51ba)dang po ni/ drang srong rnga bong gi dus kyi nyi ldog las da lta'i nyi zlog rnams zla ba gcig dang zhag bcu gnyis bcu gsum gyis snga bas dus mi 'grigs zhes zer la/ tha ska ra gyis nya ba'i phyi de nyin nas 'dzin pa na/ gso sbyong zhag mi thub mgos nya ba la 'grigs dgos pa'i skyon yod pa dang*/ phyi ma ltar na dbyar thon pa dang*/ chu rlabs bri zhing lo 'dab ser po ma gyur tsam du dgag dbye byed dgos shing*/ de'i tshe na ras chen dgag dbye thon nas zla phyed du bcang ba yang don ldan du 'gyur bas mi 'thad ces mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa gnyags phu pas gsungs/ gso sbyong gi gnas ni mtshams chen bcad pa der bya/ mtshams che chung gnyis ka bcad na chung ba nas thon te che bar bya/ che ba ma bcad na gso sbyong la sogs las thams cad chung ba der bya/ rtsig pas bskor na de nyid mtshams yin no// dge slong dag pa'am ltung ba mi mthun pa yod kyang bshags yul du rung bas las la ma 'dus gong du ltung ba rnams mthol bshags dang*/ 'chab nyes la sogs pa bshags par bya la/ lhag ma dang*/ sbom po dang*/ spang ltung rnams ni gang zag khyad par can la bshags pas 'dag kyang*/ gzhan chad las kyi sgo nas bshags dgos pas/ de ma sgrub pas las kyi kha bska nga nas 'du na/ gang zag so so'i rgyud kyi thun mong min pa rnams thun mong min pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ dge 'dun rim gyis ltung ba thun mong pa rnams dge 'dun gyis gsol ba'i las kyis byin rlabs bya'o// de nas gnas (52na)der gaṇḍi brdung*/ mchil lh+wam phud/

snam sbyar gyon/ mdo bskul/ rgyun chags gsum bton/ spyi bshags byed par spro na yang bya/ der sum brgya pa las/ gal te mngon sum gsungs pa med gyur kyang*// dgag dbye gsungs phyir 'di na gso sbyong yod// ces pa dge tshul gyi 'dun dag blangs nas thos pa'i nye 'khor las bkar/ mtshams nang gi dge slong na ba dang*/ srog gam/ tshangs spyod kyi bar chad du 'gyur bas 'du bar ma nus na dge 'dun gyis mdun dag len po bskos nas blangs te dge 'dun la 'bul/ las la ma 'dus pa'i gong thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i ltung ba byin gyis ma brlabs na skabs 'dir byin gyis brlabs/ gnas der las kyi mtshams bu chung gcod na/ gding ba bzhi bcu shong ba yan chad/ dpag tshad gnyis tshun chad gang 'os la mtshan ma brtan po btsugs te dge 'dun la go bar byas nas las bya'o// de nas gnas la blo mthun bya zhing*/ gso sbyong dngos la/ 'don pa po gnas brtan gyis sam/ des mi thon na gnyis pa'am/ gsum pa'am/ mi thon na res mos kyis 'don cing*/ tshig gcig kyang ma 'khrul bar blo nas thon pas 'don la/ rdug na gzhan gyis 'don no// 'don pa yang rnam pa lnga ste/ gleng gzhi dang*/ pham pa dang*/ lhag ma dang*/ ma nges pa dang*/ ril gyis 'don pa'o// dmigs bsal ni/ rkyen dbang gis lam du yid kyis byin gyis brlab pa'am/ gnas gcig na (52ba)dge slong gcig las med na 'dug la/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bco lnga pa yin la/ bdag dge slong 'di zhes bya ba'i gso sbyong yang bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong 'di zhes bgyi ba bar chad kyi chos rnams yongs su dag go zhes kyang bdag smra na/ bdag yongs su dag par lha rnams kyis bzung du gsol// bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya bas tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ deng gso sbyong byin gyis brlab bo// gang gi tshe dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rnyed pa de'i tshe dge 'dun dang lhan gcig gso sbyong rgya cher nyams su myong bar bya zhing so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don par bya'o// zhes lan gsum brjod cing yid la bsam mo// dge slong gnyis sam gsum yod na phan tshul dgongs gsol mngon du byas te rjes nas thabs legs bya/

de tsam ma grub na chos rnams thams cad ces sogs kyi shlau ka phyed bzhi tsam 'don no// gnyis pa dbyar gnas la/ mdo rtsa bar/ dbyar gnas par khas blang bar bya'o// zla ba gsum du'o// tshes bcu drug pa'o// dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya'i phyi de nyin par bgyi'o// dbyar zla tha chung gi nya'i'o// zhes pa dbyar snga ma dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya la sbyor ba tshul 'jug dang*/ de'i phyi de nyin dbyar zla tha chung gi mar gyi tshes gcig la khas len bya/ dbyar phyi ma dang dbyar zla tha chung gi nya la sbyor ba/ de'i phyi de nyin ston ra ba'i mar gyi tshes gcig la khas len bya'o// 'dir yang lo mgo 'dzin tshul gyi 'jog mtshams dbyar snga ma'i khas len yang hor zla bzhi pa'i (53na)nang du dang*/ lnga pa'i nang du dang drug pa'i nang du ste lag len byed tshul bod 'dir mi 'dra ba du ma dag yod do// de nas gtsug lag khang steng g.yogs dang bcas par dbyar zla 'bring po'i chos bco lnga la gso sbyong byas nas khrims su bca' ba rnams brjod cing*/ tshul shing brims pa dang*/ gnas mal stob pa sogs byas te/ de'i tshes phyi ma la steng g.yogs dang bcas par dge slong gi mdun du tsog pur 'dug nas dbyar khas len cing*/ dbyar phyi ma la yang de bzhin du byas la/ rang gcig pu yin na dam bcas pas kyang gnas par 'gyur la nyes byas bskyed do// dbyar nang du chos ldan gyi bya ba la mtshams kyi phyi rol tu 'gro dgos na mtshams nang du dge slong chos dgu ldan kyi drung du tsog pur 'dug ste dgung 'dun byin gyis brlabs te phyi rol tu 'gro bar bya'o// gal te zhag bdun phan bzhi bcu tshun gyi phyi rol du 'gro dgos na zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol zhing*/ dge 'dun gyi ched yin na spro ba dri zhing*/ rang don yin na dri mi dgos pas/ 'gro ba pos dge 'dun la gsol ba lan gsum btab nas dge 'dun gyi las kyis zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba sbyin no// gsum pa dgag dbye la/

sbyor ba ni dgag dbye 'byung ba'i zhag bdun nam zla ba phyed kyi bar gang yang rung ba nas mkhon yod na bzod gsol dang*/ gtsug lag khang brgyan/ nya'i nyin par rtswa dūr ba sta gon bya/ dge 'dun 'dus zin nas phyag byas la 'greng ste 'dud pa dang bcas pas dbyar nang du thugs (53ba)dang 'gal ba thams cad bzod par gsol// rgyun chags gsum pa nas tshul khrims rnam dag gi mdo 'don pa yan chad gso sbyong bzhin byas pa'i rjes la dge tshul rnams bkar te/ 'dun dag len pa dang*/ bshags sdom byin rlabs dang*/ gnas la blo mthun rnams bya/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni las byed pas dgag dbye byed par bsgo bar 'os pa la spro ba dris nas/ gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis bsko ba'i las byas nas dgag dbye bya ba'i phyir gsol ba'i las byas pa'i rjes la/ rgan rim gyis rtswa dūr ba brims/ de nas dge slong gzhan rnams gsum man chad kyis bskos pa'i dge slong gi drung du tsog pur 'dug /yul dang byed pa po'i lag pas rtswa bzung*/ rkang pas kyang cung zad mnan nas dgag dbye'i cho ga lan gsum brjod/ gnod pa 'byung ba sogs kyi dgos pa yod na cho ga lan gcig gam gnyis brjod pas kyang 'grub/ de nas rtswa chun bgrangs te gtsug lag khang 'di zhes bya ba 'dir dge slong 'di snyed kyis dgag dbye mdzad do// zhes go bar byas nas/ dge 'dun gzhan rnams kyis kyang legs par dgag dbye mdzad do// shin tu dgag dbye mdzad do// zhes brjod/ de nas bskos pas nad pa sogs dgag dbye lan dgos kyi sar phyin nas kyang blangs te dge 'dun la brjod/ de nas rdzas kyi dgag dbye sogs cho ga las shes so// dge slong bzhi las med na dgag dbye byed pa bsko mi rung bas mi bsko bar gsol ba'i las dang dgag dbye gong bzhin bya'o// dge slong gnyis gsum las (54na)med na dgag dbye byin gyis brlab bo// tshogs kyi dgag dbye ni zla ba phyed dang gnyis tsam song ngam/

nya stong gi dus min par rkyen blo bur gyis gyes dgos byung na phan tshun gcig la gcig rgan na phyag byas la dgag dbye'i cho ga bya'o// dge slong kun mi gyes kyang dge slong gang rung rkyen dbang gis gyes dgos byung na yang cho ga 'di ltar rung ngo*// dgag dbye byas nas gso sbyong yang des grub la/ rkyen dbang gis gso sbyong gnyis sam gsum thal nas dgag dbye byar rung ba ni gnas der dge slong 'thab dkrol ba 'ong na de ltar bya'o// gnyis pa bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen la gos/ sman/ gnas mal lo// dang po la bag yangs dang 'brel ba sra brkyang*/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang 'brel ba gos/ dmigs bsal dang 'brel ba ko lpags kyi gzhi'o// dang po ni/ sra brkyang zhes kyang bya/ gtan pa zhes kyang bya ba de 'ding ba'i gnas/ dbyar khas blangs pa'am/ gding khar mtshams gcig tu byas la/ dus dgag dbye thon pa'i phyi de nyin tshes bcu drug la/ yun spyir gtang du zla ba lngar 'ding ba po dge slong sdom ldan shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa/ chos gzhan ma yin pa/ mtshams kyi nang du gnas pa/ dbyar snga ma khas blangs shing ma ral bas 'ding ba'i dngos po dbyar snga ma'i rnyed pa'i rgyu las byung zhing dgag dbye'i gong du grub cing*/ 'ding ba'i nyin la bzo grub pa/ dge 'dun gyi yin pa/ chos gos gsum rung ba tshad ldan no// 'ding ba'i cho ga la sbyor (54ba)ba ni rang rang gi chos gos kyi byin rlabs phyung ste dge 'dun gyi chos gos 'di ni sra brkyang du 'dings par 'gyur ro zhes tshogs par smos nas/ blo mthun pa dang*/ byed pa po gsol gnyis kyis bsko ba dang*/ gsol ba byas nas de la gtad pa dang*/ des kyang 'dings bar 'gyur ro// 'ding ngo*// bting ngo snyam pa'i bsam pa gsum bskyed/ tshogs pa la tshe dang ldan pa dag /bdag sra brkyang 'ding bar 'gyur gyi zhes sogs brjod/ chos gos rnams bkru ba dang*/ drub pa dang*/

kha bsgyur ba'i las gsum byas nas 'du ba'i las rjes su bsgrub par bya'o// dngos gzhi ni brkos pa'i dge slong des sra brkyang bting ba'i sngags lan gsum brjod/ rjes ni dge slong re re'i mdun du 'dug ste/ bting ngo zhes lan gsum du go bar byas/ sa brkyang dbyung ba ni sa brkyang gis mtshams gzhan du phyin pa dang*/ sra brkyang gi bdag du brkos pa'i dge slong mtshams gzhan du skya rengs shar ba dang*/ mtshams der gtogs pa'i dge slong thams cad tshad pa sogs kyis nang du sdod med par gyur pa dang*/ las kyi cho gas dbyung ba'o// bting ba'i phan yon ni/ 'chang 'bral 'jog gsum dang*/ yang yang za ba/ 'dus bshad za ba/ ma smras pa grong 'gro/ gos bslang ba sogs kyi ltung ba khegs/ 'ding ba la gtogs pa'i dge slong yul gzhan na 'dug kyang*/ sra brkyang dang 'brel ba'i rnyed pa thun mong du dbang ba'o// gnyis pa gos la bcu ste/ bsgyub lugs/ dbye ba/ so so'i mtshan (55na)nyid/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga /'jig pa'i rgyu/ 'chang ba'i bsam pa/ longs spyod pa'i gang zag /longs spyod pa'i cho ga /dgos pa/ mjug tu ji ltar bya ba'o// dang po la/ dra ba/ drub pa/ kha bsgyur ba'o// gnyis pa la 'tsho ba/ mkho ba/ lhag pa'i yo byad do// dang po la/ dngos dang*/ yo byad kyi gso gnyis/ dang po la bcu gsum ste/ snam sbyar/ bla gos/ mthang gos/ shams thabs/ sham thabs kyi gzan/ rngul gzan/ rngul gzan gyi gzan/ gdong phyis/ rnag gzan/ g.yan dgab/ skra bzed/ gding ba/ ras chen no// gnyis pa ni/ stan la sogs pa'o// gsum pa la 'tsho ba'i yo byad ni/ rgyu rung ba ras bal sogs ha cang ngan pa dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba sogs bzang ba min pa/ srin bal dang dar sogs rung ba bdun po rnams la grub pa/ kha dog ngur smrig dang*/ sngon po dang*/ btsag gis ུ༈༈༈ra ba/ spu can/ lug ru 'khyim lta bu ma bkag cing gnang ba'o// sham thabs kyi gzan sham thabs dang mnyam la/

gdong phyis khru gang ba/ rnag gzan bla gos dang mnyam pa/ g.yan dgab srid du khru drug dang zheng khru gsum/ skra bzed zheng du khru phyed dang gnyis pa/ srid du khru gsum/ rngul gzan dang rngul gzan gyi gzan bla gos dang mnyam pa/ 'tsho ba'i don du ni re re gnang gi/gnyis pa la sogs ma gnang zhing*/ rang ming gis rlob pa'o// mkho ba'i (55ba)yo byad ni khru gang yan chad rang gzhan thun mong gi don du brlabs pa'o// lhag po ni gzhan kho na'i don du rlob ste/ gzhan la yid gtad de'i// bzhi pa ni/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ lus dang bsam pa rang bzhin du gnas pa/ mtshan dang lta ba mthun pa/ dge slong gi sdom pa dag pa ste/ dge slong chos lnga ldan gyi mdun du lh+wam phud/ rgan na phyag byas/ 'greng ste gnyis kas lag pas chos gos bzung*/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol// bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba'i chos gos bgyis lags pa/ rung ba spyad par 'os pa 'di chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo// zhes gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya'o// yo byad kyi gos stan ska rag sogs la yang 'don pa bsgyur ro// mkho ba'i yo byad la/ dgongs gsol/ yo byad 'di bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i mkho ba'i yo byad kyi gos su byin gyis brlab bo// gsum dang thabs legs/ lhag po'i byin rlabs ni/ dgongs gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba'i yo byad rung ba ma bgyis pa/ rung bar bgyi bar 'os pa 'di mkhan po rung bar bgyi'o// mkhan po la yid brtan te bcang bar bgyi'o// gsum dang thabs legs bya'o// lnga pa la dge slong las nyams pa spang pa/ bsngos pa/ 'phrog pa/ brlag pa/ byin rlabs phyung ba/ gzhan la yid brten pa/ shi ba la shi bar shes pas 'jig go /drug pa ni/ rnam sbyar ni mu stegs pa dang ma rdzogs pa las khyad par du bya ba/ (56na)bla gos mthang gos ni stod smad gcer ba spang ba'i don dang*/

yo byad thams cad mi rtag pa'i bsam pas bcang zhing*/ mkho ba'i ni dkon mchog mchod pa'am/ chos phyir lus gso ba'i don dang*/ lhag po ni mkhan po sogs kyi don du bsam pa'o// bdun pa ni/ spyir rab byung tshul khrims dang ldan pa dang*/ snam sbyar ni dge slong gis so// brgyad pa ni/ chud 'dzad pa dang ma gus pa dang*/ rtags gzhan du gyur pa sogs spangs te bcang bar bya'o// dgu pa bslab pa'i dgos pa ni/ dngos su lhag po bcang ba sogs kyi ltung ba khegs shing*/ brgyud nas gos la zhen pa dang bral ba'o// bcu pa la rnying zhing zad na lhag po blan/ zung gdab/ ral na btsem bcos mi rung na sbyin bdag gi ched du 'jim pa dang bsres nas gtsug lag khang gi zhal gso bya'o// gsum pa ko lpags kyi gzhi las/ mtha' 'khob tu lh+wam dang ko lpags bsten du rung zhing*/ de'i khyad par khra bo dang*/ gser sogs kyis sprad pa dang*/ sgra sgrog pa dang*/ mthil rim pa gnyis mi rung zhing*/ gla nga po che dang*/ stag /seng ge/rta bong sogs kyi rko lpags mi sbyar ro// gnyis pa bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen sman la/ dngos dang*/ gang gis longs spyod pa/ rung khang ji ltar bya ba'o// dang po la/ ngo bo/ mtshan nyid/ ming 'dogs pa'i rgyu/ dgos pa/ bsten tshul/ byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ dus su rung ba// na tshod du rung ba/ zhag bdun pa/ (56ba)'tsho ba'i bar du bcang ba'o// dang po ni/ bza' ba lnga dang*/ bca' ba lnga sogs skya rengs shar nas gung tshig gi thun la brten du rung ba'o// thun tshod du rung ba ni/ tso tsa dang*/ chu shing gi 'bras bu dang*/ rgya shug dang*/ a shāttha dang*/ u dum wā ra dang*/ pa ru sha ka dang*/ rgun chu dang*/ 'bra go'i ltung ba ste/ bcos pa'i tshwa dang*/ 'bru'i tshwa dang*/ zho kha chu dang*/ dar ba'i dwangs ma/ rtsa ba mo rung chu btab pa/ tshags kyis btsags pa/ sla ba bzhin snang ba'o// zhag bdun pa ni 'bru mar dang*/ zhun mar dang*/

sbrang rtsi dang*/ bu ram gyi dbu ba'o// mar dkar zhag bdun pa yin min du 'dod lugs gnyis las/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa nad pa dang*/ lam zhugs dang*/ dge brkos dang lag gi gla rnams kyis bsten du rung la/ gzhan gyis mi rung*/ 'tsho bcang ni me tog dang 'dab ma dang rtsa ba dang 'bras bu'i sman te a bar skyur gsum sogs so// gnyis pa la/ dus rung gis bkres pa sel ba la gtso bor gyur cing phyi dro bzar mi rung ba'o// thun tshod du rung ba ni rab byung gnang zhing*/ skom pa sel ba la gtso bor gyur pa/ btung ba de'i dang sbyor thun dang po la g.yos su byas pa thun gnyis par mi btung ba'o// zhag bdun pa ni/ bkres pa dang rlung nad sel zhing byin gyis ma brlabs na dus thams cad du rung la/ byin gyis brlabs na zhag bdun las lhag por mi rlob pa'o// 'tsho bcang ni nad sel ba la gtso bor gyur cing*/ nad zhi ba'i (57na)mtha' tshun chad du rung ba'o// gsum pa ni/ snga dro'i dus kho na sogs rang ming gis shes pa'o// bzhi pa ni bkres pa sogs gong bzhin no// lnga pa ni/ mig sman dang dom lpags sogs lus kyis bsten pa dang*/ nad pas dus rung dus min du bsten pa'o// drug pa ni// na tshod du rung ba la snga dro rung chu gtor/ byin len byas nas yul rten gnyis ka 'greng ste lag pa g.yon du bzhag nas g.yas pa bkab te dgongs gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i thun tshod du rung ba'i sman 'di bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis bgyi bar thun tshod du rung bar byin gyis brlab bo// zhes gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya'o// zhag bdun pa dang 'tsho bcang la'ang de bzhin no// lhag po'i sman byin gyis rlob na/ dgongs gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sman lhag po rung ba ma bgyis pa/ rung ba bgyi bar 'os pa 'di mkhan po'i lag par rung bar bgyi'o// mkhan po la yid gtad de bcang bar bgyi'o// rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bcang bar bgyi'o// zhes gsum dang*/

thabs legs bya/ byin rlabs dbyung ba ni/ dgongs gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sman 'di gang gi thun tshod du rung bar byin gyis brlabs pa las/ de lta bas na dngos po de nyid slar dbyung bar bgyi'o// zhes gsum dang*/ thabs legs/ lhag pa'i dbyung ba ni/ dgongs gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sman lhag po (57ba)'di gang gi tshe mkhan po'i lag par rung bar bgyis pa la/ de lta bas na dngos po de nyid slar dbyung bar bgyi'o// zhes gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya'o// 'jig rgyu ni/ byin len zhig pa dang*/ ro 'gyur ba/ cho gas phyung ba/ rang rang gi dus 'das pa'o// gnyis pa gang gis longs spyod pa ni/ spyir btang du rab byung tshul khrims rnam dag dang ldan pa myang 'das kyi bsam pa can gyis bcang zhing*/ dmigs bsal pha ma sogs slong ba la sbyin no// sman gyi snod lhung bzed rlob pa ni/ yul dang rten gnyis ka 'greng ste gnyis ka'i lag pa g.yon par lhung bzed bzhag /g.yas pa gnyis kas steng du bkab ste dgongs gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i lhung bzed zas la spyad par 'os pa drang srong gi snod 'di slong ba'i snod du byin gyis brlab bo// zhes gsum dang thabs legs bya/ lhung bzed mkho ba dang lhag pa la yang gos kyi skabs bzhin 'don pa bsgyur/ dbyung ba ni/ lag pa g.yas pas kha nas bzung ste dgongs gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i lhung bzed zas la spyad par 'os pa/ drang srong gi snod 'di bslang ba'i snod du byin gyis brlabs pa las/ rkyen de lta bas na dngos po slar dbyung bar bgyi'o// zhes gsum dang thabs legs bya/ gsum pa rung khang byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gnas sgo khang dang shing drung dang gla nga po'i ra ba sogs min pa/ gnas nye 'khor can dang*/ bla gab can yin pa/ rung khang du byin gyis ma (58na)brlabs pa la/ dge 'dun nam gang zag gi don du rlob tshul bzhi ste/

rdo bteg pa'i mtha' las dbyung ba/ phyis las gsar pa dang bcas pa'i dus su byung ba/ dge slong gnas pa dang ma bral ba'i dus su byung ba/ gang zag gcig pu'am grogs dang bcas pa'i dus su byung ba ste bzhi las/ dang po dang bzhi pa ni/ so phag 'grem dus lag gi blas grogs bcas 'dug pa'i spyod lam gyis/ gzhi 'di ni dge 'dun gyi rung khang du 'gyur ro// zhes gsal zhing tshig tu brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ dus der dge slong mang po 'dug la gcig car tshe dang ldan pa dag gzhi 'di ni dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par 'gyur bar sems sdud shig ces brjod// gsum pa ni/ dge 'dun gyi dbus su las mkhan gyis dge gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par blo mthun par bzhed na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par blo mthun par bgyi'o// 'di ni gsol ba'o// brjod pa mjug sdud dang bcas pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyi ba'am/ lag pa (58ba)nang mtshams phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung khang gi gnas su bzhed de/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis gnas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis pa'am lags pa phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi rung ba'i khang par blo mthun par bgyi na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gnas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis pa'am lags pa phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyis rung ba'i khang par blo mthun par mdzad pa bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung zhig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag gis ni gsungs shig
